content: history.replaceState(state, unused, url) replaces the CURRENT history entry without adding a new one and WITHOUT firing hashchange/popstate navigation — updating the URL bar silently (same-origin url required, SecurityError otherwise). Baseline since 2015. D10-03 implication: stripping the /h/<highlightId> suffix via history.replaceState(null,'','#/article/<id>') avoids re-triggering the App.tsx hashchange router (setting location.hash WOULD fire hashchange and re-parse), and Back still returns to #/review because the article entry replaced — not pushed — its own entry.
